fact: ZICTA donated to Chinsali Special School in 2024 15 desktop computers, five with JAWS screen-reading software, plus a braille printer and internet connectivity, for a school of 768 learners including 213 with disabilities.
Under ZICTA's Inclusive ICT Support Programme, St Mary's Special School for the Visually Impaired in Solwezi received a braille printer, JAWS-enabled computers and other ICT tools in 2020/21.
